note: Rewritten from the species description in Scheffrahn & Carrijo 2020, originally in English; the original explicitly states 'Imago (unknown)' for this species, hence no alate section; the text omits locality, type material, distribution, ecology and molecular analyses, and plate information is not recorded; measurements follow Table 1 of the original (15 soldiers, 8 colonies, with means).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is distinctly smaller than R. laticollis. Antennal ridges and anterolateral ridges smooth, moderately sclerotized and glossy; in R. rufus and R. volcanensis these two ridges are angular, darkly sclerotized and rugose. The head width at the antennae is less than the span between the outer edges of the antennal ridges, whereas in the latter two the two are equal. The outer corners of the anterolateral ridges do not rise above the frontal plane, whereas in the latter two they do.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule pale orange brown in dorsal view from the frons to the middle of the vertex, grading to pale yellowish brown on the occiput; anterior part of the mandibles almost black, orange brown from the middle to the base; antennal ridges, anterolateral ridges and genal angles dark brown. In ventral view the postmentum orange brown, the head capsule pale yellowish brown. Head capsule narrow and elongate, rectangular; lateral margins distinctly concave medially, evenly setose except on the occiput. Pronotum much wider than long, with scattered setae, denser on the lateral margins, anterior margin shallowly concave. Frontal ridges forming a shallow groove, at about 30° to the plane of the vertex. In profile the outer corners of the anterolateral ridges do not rise above the frontal plane. Antennal ridges and anterolateral ridges bare and smooth, the outer edge of each ridge bent at about 120°. Eye spots small, narrow and oblique, only slightly paler than the head capsule. Third antennal segment club-shaped, about as long as the second and fourth segments combined. Mandibles about two-thirds the length of the head capsule, apex curved through about 60°, the outer edge straight in the middle of the blade, with a large shallow swelling at the base.
Measurements (mm, means in parentheses; n=15, 8 colonies): head length to lateral mandible base 2.13—2.69 (2.39), maximum head width 1.44—1.72 (1.60), head height including hypopharynx 1.15—1.45 (1.33), pronotum length 0.98—1.25 (1.13), pronotum width 1.60—2.03 (1.76), antenna 11—16 segments (13.7), third antennal segment length 0.18—0.25 (0.21).
